gold_rationale: TH positivity without authentic midbrain floor-plate identity (FOXA2/LMX1A low in TH+ cells) means the product is not genuine A9 mDA neurons. The forebrain (FOXG1+) and serotonergic (5-HT/TPH2+) contamination plus an A10/VTA-skewed rather than A9/SNc phenotype are disqualifying: non-A9 cells will not restore nigrostriatal dopaminergic tone, and serotonergic contamination is a recognized cause of graft-induced dyskinesias. Clean residual-pluripotency QC does not rescue a regionally mis-specified product. The correct decision is No-Go (at most a Conditional Go contingent on re-deriving authentic A9 mDA neurons and removing serotonergic/forebrain contamination via floor-plate protocol correction and marker-based sorting such as CORIN+).
required_concepts: TH positivity is insufficient without A9 midbrain identity
midbrain floor-plate markers FOXA2 / LMX1A low
release criteria for regional identity / purity
red_flags: issues a Go treating TH positivity as sufficient despite low FOXA2/LMX1A
ignores serotonergic contamination and graft-induced-dyskinesia risk
ignores forebrain / off-target regional contamination or A9-vs-A10 identity
treats clean residual-pluripotency QC as making the product ready
